title: Checkrd Pricing Bundle
description: Signed, versioned list-price bundle the WASM core verifies and uses to compute per-call cost (TDD App. E). Distributed as the payload of a DSSE envelope with payloadType application/vnd.checkrd.pricing-bundle+json.

schema_version.description: Bundle wrapper format version. The verifier rejects unknown versions (FFI -20).

version.description: Monotonically increasing bundle version; rollback to a lower version is rejected (FFI -21).

signed_at.description: Unix seconds at signing time; stale (> max_age) or future-dated bundles are rejected (FFI -22 / -23).

skus.description: Priced models. Resolution is most-specific glob wins; tie -> newest effective_from; no match -> unpriced_model.

rounding.description: Rounding mode applied per line item so independent implementations reproduce identical signed cost (ADR-003).

priceUnit.description: Unit the per-unit prices are quoted in. v1 prices are per 1,000,000 tokens.

priceSource.description: list = published list price; org = org-negotiated overlay (wins via merge precedence).

sku_id.description: Stable identifier; surfaces as the FOCUS SkuId.

provider.description: OTel gen_ai well-known provider name (openai, anthropic, ...).

model_match.description: Glob over the model id (*, ** per url.rs); most-specific match wins, tie -> newest effective_from.

input_usd_micros_per_unit.description: Micro-USD per unit of input tokens.

output_usd_micros_per_unit.description: Micro-USD per unit of output tokens.

cache_read_usd_micros_per_unit.description: Micro-USD per unit of cache-read input tokens, when priced separately.

cache_write_usd_micros_per_unit.description: Micro-USD per unit of cache-write / cache-creation tokens, when priced separately.

default_max_output_tokens.description: Output-token cap used to size the pre-flight reserve when a request does not cap output (ADR-008).

effective_from.description: Unix seconds from which this SKU is in effect.

deprecated_after.description: Unix seconds after which this SKU should not be used, if set.
